svg.aria-label: 16-bit Mega Drive and front-loading Mega CD station with an Ink and Leaf CRT and complete Vega logo
svg.title: Mega Drive with Mega CD expansion station
svg.metadata: Combined Mega Drive and 1991 front-loading Mega CD expansion, with Sega three-button pad. Hardware reference: https://www.sega.jp/history/hard/mega-cd/. Complete Vega logo pairs the original arcade wordmark mask and real daisy.
